recentItems.title: Malema takes manifesto to Nelson Mandela Bay
recentItems.description:
EFF party leader, Julius Malema, brings the party's manifesto to Nelson Mandela Bay. 

The EFF currently holds 8 seats in the 120 seat council of the metro. 

SABC News Reporter Sisipho Ngcumbe is there with more.

recentItems.title: GBVF | Ekurhuleni residents march against GBV
recentItems.description:
A growing wave of anger is taking over the streets of Ekurhuleni today, as residents of Kempton Park, Brakpan and Kwa-Thema march against the killing of women. 

It comes after twelve women were murdered across the region since July, with their bodies discovered dumped in different parts of Ekurhuleni. 

The marchers are demanding safer communities and renewed action against gender-based violence and femicide. SABC News Reporter Nomvuyo Ntanjana is there with the latest.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: National tourism minister to address Morame Conference at Mogale City today
recentItems.description:
COGTA Portfolio Committee Chairperson Dr Zweli Mkhize is set to address the Religious Freedom Imbizo at the Castle of Good Hope in Cape Town. 

His address will focus on the committee's work relating to the Cultural, Religious and Linguistic Rights Commission's Section 22 process, which is examining allegations of exploitation and abuse by pastors. 

SABC News Reporter Yamkela Mtshiyo has more.

recentItems.title: Men urged to play active role in fighting GBV
recentItems.description:
Gender-based violence remains one of the most pressing social issues affecting individuals, families and communities. While women and girls bear the brunt of GBV, men have a crucial role to play in understanding, preventing and responding to it. 

We explore men's perspectives by looking at the attitudes, beliefs, social expectations and behaviours that may contribute to GBV, and how men can be part of prevention and positive change. 

We are joined by the Chairman of the South African Leadership Gentlemen's Club, Buti Seipei.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: SABCNews PM Headlines @12H00 | 03 October 2026
recentItems.description:
* Police are investigating the stabbing of 14-year-old twins in Mamelodi West.

* Ekurhuleni is bracing for a morning of action, with residents expected to take to the streets to protest gender-based violence and femicide. The gathering comes as concern grows over the recent killings of women in the area

* Former deputy head of Crime Intelligence, Feroz Khan has until noon today to file his statement relating to his in-camera evidence before the Madlanga Commission. The Commission ruled yesterday that Khan's questioning will take place in camera on Monday.

* Staying with tha story, the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights says tackling GBV and femicide in South Africa will require action on several fronts, following its fact-finding mission.

* There are NO tickets left for the 2026 MTN8 Final. Moses Mabhida Stadium is set for a packed house as Mamelodi Sundowns and Orlando Pirates meet in Durban next week for the MTN8 crown.

* Bafana Bafana head coach Pitso Mosimane has expressed concern about the growing number of injuries, which has left the national team short of options in some key positions.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | Regulations for party election broadcasts and political adverts
recentItems.description:
It's just over a month to go before the November 4th polls, and during this election period our audience may see a number of political advertisements. Recently the High Court in Pretoria ordered a number of regulations that seek to clarify party election broadcasts and political advertisements.

It's a legal battle between Media Monitoring Africa - now known as Moxii Africa - and the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa.

Justine Limpitlaw, Electronic Communications Law Consultant and Associate at the LINK Centre at Wits - who provided support to Moxii Africa - speaks to us about this case.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: GBVF | GBV through the eyes of the deaf
recentItems.description:
As our nation confronts another grim chapter in its fight against gender-based violence, with the discovery of multiple women's bodies in Ekurhuleni, urgent questions are once again being raised about the safety of women.

But for Deaf and hard-of-hearing survivors, getting help can come with an additional barrier: being heard. 

As we close Deaf Awareness Month, we're questioning whether South Africa's response to GBV is accessible to everyone, and what needs to change. 

Joining us to unpack this is Fatima Cele, the Executive Director of the Neema Foundation.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
